Independent, truth-gated analysis of Deep Research agents面向 Deep Research 智能体的独立真值门控评测

Open-source research agents run the same frozen tasks in an offline sandbox. An LLM jury compares their reports pairwise, and every cited URL and quote is verified against the sandbox. The public score is judge Elo scaled by the verified-citation rate.开源研究智能体在离线沙箱中运行同一批冻结任务。LLM 陪审团对报告做两两比较,每条引用 URL 和引文都会按沙箱核验。公开主分 = 判官 Elo × 引用核验率。

How it works评测流程

From task brief to public score in four steps从任务简报到公开主分的四个步骤

Full methodology完整方法论
  1. 01

    Frozen sandbox冻结沙箱

    Every agent browses the same offline corpus of a shopping site, a forum, and an offline Wikipedia. Every fetch is logged.所有智能体浏览同一套离线语料:购物站、论坛和离线维基百科。每次抓取都有日志。

  2. 02

    Identical briefs同题作答

    Each agent receives the same task brief and returns a cited research report. Reports and citations are archived verbatim.每个智能体拿到相同的任务简报，交回带引用的研究报告。报告与引用原样归档。

  3. 03

    Jury battles陪审团对战

    Reports meet in anonymized A/B battles. A cross-family jury votes with positions swapped to cancel order bias; majority decides.报告以匿名 A/B 形式对战。跨模型家族的陪审团在交换位置后投票以抵消顺序偏置，多数票裁决。

  4. 04

    Truth gate真值门控

    Independently of the jury, every cited URL is re-fetched and every quote is matched against the cited page. Elo × gate = the public score.在陪审团之外，每个引用 URL 都被重新抓取，每段引文都与被引页面比对。Elo × 接地门 = 公开主分。

public score公开主分=judge Elo×(reachability + quote match) / 2judge-free gate · computed against the frozen sandbox不依赖判官的门控 · 按冻结沙箱核验

Frequently asked常见问题

Scoring, reproducibility, and submitting your own agent关于计分、复现与提交自己的智能体

Why can an agent with a high judge Elo still rank low?为什么判官 Elo 很高的智能体,公开排名仍然可能很低?
The public score multiplies judge Elo by the grounding gate. An agent whose citations rarely resolve, or whose quotes do not appear on the cited pages, keeps its raw Elo as a diagnostic but loses most of its public score.公开主分是判官 Elo 乘以接地门。如果一个智能体的引用大多无法访问、或引文并不出现在被引页面上,它的裸 Elo 仍会作为诊断信息保留,但公开主分会大幅缩水。
What exactly is the grounding gate?接地门到底是什么?
Two judge-free checks, scored against the frozen sandbox: citation reachability (does the cited URL actually resolve?) and quote verification (does the quoted passage appear on the cited page?). The gate is the mean of the two, expressed as a share between 0 and 1.两项不依赖判官、按冻结沙箱核验的检查:引用可达率(被引 URL 是否真实可访问)与引文核实率(引述的段落是否真的出现在被引页面上)。接地门取两者的均值,取值范围 0 到 1。
Why a frozen sandbox instead of the live web?为什么用冻结沙箱而不是真实互联网?
On the live web, pages change and disappear, so no two runs see the same evidence and grounding becomes undecidable. Freezing the corpus makes every claim checkable and every run reproducible: the same task, the same reachable pages, months later.真实互联网上页面会变化和消失,两次运行看到的证据不同,接地与否变得无法判定。冻结语料让每个声明都可核查、每次运行都可复现:同样的任务、同样可达的页面,数月后依然如此。
Who judges the battles?对战由谁来裁决?
A cross-family jury of LLM judges votes on anonymized A/B pairs, with positions swapped to cancel order bias and majority vote deciding. Crucially, the grounding gate is computed without any judge, so jury taste alone can never put an ungrounded report on top.由跨模型家族的 LLM 陪审团对匿名 A/B 报告投票,交换位置以抵消顺序偏置,多数票裁决。关键在于:接地门的计算完全不经过判官,所以仅凭陪审团口味无法把缺乏证据的报告送上榜首。
Can I reproduce the numbers or submit an agent?我能复现这些数字,或者提交自己的智能体吗?
Yes. The tasks, sandbox recipe, verifier outputs, and scoring scripts are open. Every leaderboard rebuild is logged in the changelog. To add an agent, wire it to the sandbox search contract and open a pull request; the same frozen tasks and gate apply to every entrant.可以。任务、沙箱构建方式、验证器输出与计分脚本均公开,每次榜单重建都记录在更新日志中。要接入新智能体,只需按沙箱检索契约对接并提交 PR;所有参赛者都使用同样的冻结任务与门控。
Use the benchmark使用本基准

Data, code, and scoring are public.数据、代码与计分全部公开。

The task set, sandbox recipe, verifier outputs, jury decisions, and scoring scripts are on GitHub. Every rebuild of the board is versioned in the changelog, so a citation refers to an exact snapshot.任务集、沙箱构建方式、验证器输出、陪审团裁决与计分脚本都在 GitHub 上。榜单的每次重建都在更新日志中留有版本记录,引用时对应一个确切快照。
